title: [v0.93.1] Remove post-split ADL repository cruft after podcast migration
summary: After podcast PR1286 integrates, remove post-split ADL cruft while preserving public behavior, historical evidence and current authority.
non_goals_inline: No podcast ownership overlap, deletion of sole evidence copies, history rewrite, private implementation restoration, Runtime or deployment changes, provider spend or shared binary replacement.
validation_plan_inline: Focused deterministic archive restoration and reference checks; wrapper absence/remaining caller contracts; mocked runner argument/order/failure propagation tests; native proof and independent exact-head review; required CI only.
notes_risks_inline: Local deterministic filesystem/docs/orchestration contracts; bounded CPU/disk, no provider/cloud calls. Archive identity checked once and restoration verified. CI integration proof remains separate.
